name: astra-advisor
description: Codex-native dynamic orchestration with GPT-6 Astra as the primary advisor, native GPT-5.6 subagents, and Claude models through a bridge subagent.

interface.shortDescription: Use GPT-6 Astra to plan, route, verify, and review work dynamically across GPT and Claude models.
interface.longDescription: Astra Advisor keeps GPT-6 Astra in the primary session at the effort selected by the user. Astra can combine useful parent work with bounded native Codex subagents, choosing gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-terra, or gpt-5.6-luna and a supported effort from live tool metadata, and can reach claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5, or claude-haiku-4-5 through a cheap native bridge subagent (the least expensive model the live spawn schema lists, currently gpt-5.6-luna at low effort) that runs Claude Code headlessly and relays its result verbatim. ChatGPT Work cloud tasks remain bounded by the create_thread schema and do not promise arbitrary model or effort pinning.
defaultPrompt: Use $astra-advisor:orchestration to plan, build, verify, and review this work.
Choose dynamic subagents only when bounded independent work improves delivery.
